population.source: Brazil age_distribution.csv supplied with Prem 2021 contact matrices
population.household_composition_source: PNAD COVID-19 November 2020 microdata, weighted by V1032 of household reference person

contacts.source: Prem et al. 2021 Brazil matrices supplied in Arquivo.zip; 16 five-year groups aggregated to 0-17/18-64/65+ using supplied single-year Brazil age distribution.

contact_duration.source: POLYMOD/Mossong 2008 supplied files; pooled 8 European countries. Used for duration shape only, not Brazilian contact frequency.
contact_duration.representative_hours_note: Midpoints are modelling representatives; >4h is open-ended and fixed at 5h for computation, so sensitivity analysis is required.

behavior.source: PNAD COVID-19 monthly microdata May-November 2020; questionnaire definitions retained.

hospital_capacity.source: CNES Leitos 2025, competence 202512; registered capacity, not real-time free beds.

surveillance.source: SIVEP-Gripe 2025 national records, updated 14/09/2026; hospitalized SRAG only.
surveillance.limitations: One national year is a provisional seasonal reference, not a local multi-year endemic threshold.

unidentified.beta_per_effective_contact_hour: not identified by supplied aggregate surveillance/contact-frequency data
unidentified.vaccine_efficacy: coverage files do not identify efficacy
unidentified.causal_effect_of_lockdown_school_closure: OxCGRT/PNAD describe policies/behavior, not isolated causal efficacy
unidentified.infection_fatality_risk: SIVEP is conditioned on SRAG/hospitalized cases and cannot identify IFR

scenario_assumptions.note: Absolute beta, latent/infectious periods, vaccination efficacy and several spatial/clinical counterfactuals are not identified by the supplied observational files. Defaults are conservative sensitivity settings and are never labeled as empirical estimates.

community_allocation_proxy.source: POLYMOD pooled non-home/school/work location composition; proxy, not Brazil-specific.

routine_outing_probability.explanation: Used only to decide whether an agent performs a post-school/work community outing. Brazil contact matrices still determine expected contacts and POLYMOD determines duration shape. Replace these probabilities when a compatible Brazil time-use/mobility source is calibrated.

city_mixing.explanation: Probabilities control whether a persistent destination is selected outside the agent home district. They are used to keep the fictional city epidemiologically connected. Exact origin-destination shares are not identified by the supplied datasets and should be replaced if a compatible commuting/mobility OD source is calibrated.

reinfection_wave_scenarios.explanation: The supplied surveillance/contact datasets do not identify duration of sterilizing natural immunity or the frequency of successful introductions from outside the fictional city. These values are explicit game scenarios used to allow recurrent waves and reinfection. The SIVEP COVID reinfection criterion is not interpreted as an immunity duration.

scenario_assumptions.annual_wave_schedule_explanation: Four 90-day game phases are used over the 360-day campaign. Multipliers modulate the already-high transmissibility sensitivity scenario and external introductions; they are not epidemiological forecasts.

vaccine_dose_scenarios.note: Dose 3 represents an updated/booster scenario for later variants/strains. Values are not estimates for a specific vaccine.

scenario_assumptions.playable_severity_multiplier_explanation: The playable 360-day high-transmission campaign multiplies the PNAD/SIVEP-derived severe-case proxy by 4 so hospital demand is consequential at synthetic-city scale. This is a game-balance parameter, not an observed hospitalization probability.
scenario_assumptions.unmet_care_daily_death_hazard_explanatio: A severe case that requests a bed and remains without one faces a daily synthetic death hazard while waiting, in addition to the final severity outcome. This is used to make capacity decisions consequential and is not an empirical risk estimate.

calibration_notes.single_year_age_distribution: Brazil distribution supplied with Prem/epydemix package; terminal 84+ group is represented as age 84 only for synthetic-age assignment while remaining an 84+ open interval in provenance.
calibration_notes.hospital_severity_proxy: severeProbabilityByAge is not directly observed infection-to-hospital risk. It is a hybrid model estimate combining PNAD-COVID respiratory-symptom hospitalization prevalence with SIVEP 2025 relative hospitalization incidence by broad age group and the explicit symptomatic-probability scenario.
calibration_notes.sivep_year_used_for_clinical_microdata: 2025 CSV supplied to the project. Frozen 2019-2024 Parquet files are retained as validation inputs but are not pooled into this parameter set until field harmonization across yearly schemas is run in an environment with Parquet support.
calibration_notes.cnes_capacity: CNES values are registered beds in competence 202512, not real-time free beds. Engine capacity is a reference scenario and must be overridable.
calibration_notes.polymod: POLYMOD supplies contact-duration distribution shape only; Brazil contact frequencies and age mixing come from the supplied Prem 2021 matrices.
calibration_notes.pnad: PNAD-COVID weights V1032 are used for population estimates. Social-distancing and remote-work measures are observed behavior indicators, not causal intervention efficacy.
calibration_notes.city_mixing: The V0.4 city network intentionally mixes residents across districts through persistent work, school, retail, leisure and hospital destinations. The mixing shares are explicit game-network assumptions, not empirical Brazil or Piracicaba OD estimates.
calibration_notes.reinfection_waves: Recovered agents temporarily enter R and later return to S according to pathogen-specific game-scenario windows. External introductions are modeled as exposure attempts scaled by population; vaccine protection can block a successful imported infection. These settings are scenario mechanics, not estimates from WHO/SIVEP/OxCGRT/PNAD/POLYMOD.
calibration_notes.annual_game_campaign: The playable campaign now spans 360 days in four approximately 90-day wave phases. This resolves the game-design request for four waves in one simulated year; supplied datasets do not support a deterministic four-wave calendar.
calibration_notes.unmet_care: Severe cases denied a bed accumulate denied-care days. Mortality risk is increased by an explicit scenario multiplier per denied day. This is a game-model consequence of capacity shortage, not a causal estimate of a real policy.
calibration_notes.playable_severity_balance: V0.8 increases the severe-case proxy in the playable campaign and adds a daily hazard while severe cases wait without a bed. These changes are explicitly game-balance assumptions and must not be cited as real-world clinical estimates.
